title: Eberjey x The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Ready to Set Sail
text:
It is the Ritz-Carlton Yacht Colletion's first sleepwear collaboration.
The Eberjey x Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is the first sleepwear collaboration for The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection, and the partnership ties in with Eberjey’s 30th anniversary.
“Partnering with The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is truly a dream come true for Ali and me. As we celebrate 30 years of Eberjey, we’re being ever more intentional about the company we keep, and this collaboration felt like the perfect way to mark that milestone,” said Mariela Rovito, cofounder and chief executive officer of Eberjey.
In the past the brand has done collaborations with Ilia, Lily Aldridge, L’Agence , Casa Del Sol and Maxbone .
“Since Day One, Eberjey has been about embracing rest and the rituals that come with it. What drew us to The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is the sense of ease and intentionality they create for their guests. That experience resonates deeply with what we’ve always hoped to credit through our product: moments that invite people to slow down, reconnect and savor life’s quieter luxuries,” Rovito said.
The capsule features two Eberjey classic women’s silhouettes with an exclusive wave print on a Memorable Blue custom hue, with navy piping details. The third silhouette is a men’s long classic pajama in a solid Memorable Blue hue with navy piping. Sizes run from XS to XL for women and men. All the pieces are inspired by The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection’s signature color, the movement of the waves and the view on board.
The women’s Inez Washable Silk Print long PJ set is $298, and the Inez Washable Silk Printed Short PJ Set is $278. The men’s Charles Washable Silk Long PJ Set is $298. The collection will be available starting Monday at eberjey.com and at The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection boutiques on board Evrima, IIma and Luminara.
“We hope this collaboration introduces Eberjey to a new audience, bringing together people who genuinely embody the spirit of both bands and appreciate thoughtful design, exceptional craftsmanship and elevated comfort without compromise,” Rovito said.
